note: Both sets extract exactly the nine cells of Table 5.5-4 and bind each value to the correct channel column and bandpass row (e.g., 0.2–0.45 µm UV bandpass in the UV column, 0.54–1.0 µm visible bandpass in the IR column, 0.975–1.8 µm IR bandpass in the IR column). Set A names the channel as the entity and the band as the attribute, while Set B mixes entity/attribute/condition naming (UV bandpass, UV channel, UV band; range vs. bandpass) and puts the channel in conditions, but neither misreads a value. Both equally drop the per-cell science/guide mode qualifiers (e.g., 0.3–0.45 µm in the IR column is guide mode) and both ignore the other page facts (153K/60K detectors, 1k×1k formats, 32×32 pupil image, 4" field stop, 3.8"×3.8" IFS FOV at R=40), so their coverage and accuracy are effectively identical.
